name: baseline
purpose: Check forwarding in both directions between the hosts across both MLAG pairs. Both host streams cross the inter-pair bond.

state_checks.name: Both MLAG pairs are connected, with switch-a1 and switch-b1 as MLAG primaries.
Pair A is the RSTP root bridge with switch-a1's bridge ID, and pair B reaches it through the inter-pair bond.
Every bridge port of the four switches forwards, and the host ports are edge ports.
The inter-pair bond runs with lacp-strict=no on all four switches.
Both inter-pair bond members are synchronized, collecting and distributing at all four ends.
Both cables of every host are eligible in its LACP bond.
